T1.CLINT_NM , T1.RQST_CS_CN , T1.PRNMNT_USE_BGNG_YMD , T1.PRNMNT_USE_BGNG_HR , T1.PRNMNT_USE_END_YMD , T1.PRNMNT_USE_END_HR , T1.RCPT_UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD , T1.RCPT_UNT_TASKWK_SE_NM , T1.CLR_NO , T1.CLR_NM , T1.RCPT_INST_NO , T1.RCPT_INST_NM , T1.RQST_TRPR_INFO_NO , C##RG.DEC_B64(T1.RQST_TRPR_INFO_NM) AS RQST_TRPR_INFO_NM , T1.INDV_IDNTFC_NO , T1.RQST_APLY_YN , T1.RQST_DTL_CN , T1.LINK_TYPE_SE_CD , T1.LINK_TYPE_SE_NM , T1.ATFINO , T1.TRMN_PRCS_YN , T1.RQST_INST_NO , T1.RQST_INST_NM , T2.RCPT_SE_CD , T2.RCPT_TRPR_INFO_NO , T2.RCPT_DTL_CN , T2.RCPT_YMD , T2.RRQST_RCPT_INST_NO , (SELECT RCPT_YMD FROM SEB421 WHERE SRVC_PVSN_RQST_NO = T2.SRVC_PVSN_RQST_NO AND RCPT_SE_CD = T2.RCPT_SE_CD AND RCPT_UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = T2.RCPT_UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD AND MDFCN_DT = (SELECT MIN(MDFCN_DT) FROM SEB421 WHERE SRVC_PVSN_RQST_NO = T2.SRVC_PVSN_RQST_NO AND RCPT_SE_CD = T2.RCPT_SE_CD AND RCPT_UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = T2.RCPT_UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD)) AS FIRST_RCPT_YMD , T1.CASE_TRPR_NOAP_CS_SE_CD , T1.CASE_MNG_SE_CD , T1.STU_AGRE_STS_CD , T1.STTY_AGT_AGRE_STS_CD , (SELECT CASE_PRGRS_STTS_SE_CD FROM SEB100 WHERE UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = 'U03' AND TRPR_INFO_NO = T2.RCPT_TRPR_INFO_NO AND CASE_BGNG_YMD = (SELECT MAX(CASE_BGNG_YMD) FROM SEB100 WHERE UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = 'U03' AND TRPR_INFO_NO = T2.RCPT_TRPR_INFO_NO)) AS CASE_PRGRS_STTS_SE_CD , T1.ESB_SEQ , T1.PRVC_PVSN_AGRE_YN FROM ( SELECT A.SRVC_PVSN_RQST_NO , A.RESRCE_NO , A.RQST_UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD , B.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS RQST_UNT_TASKWK_SE_NM , A.RCPT_RQST_COURS_SE_CD , C.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS RCPT_RQST_COURS_SE_NM , A.RQST_YMD , A.CLINT_NO , C##RG.DEC_B64(F.FLNM_ENCPT) AS CLINT_NM , A.RQST_CS_CN , A.PRNMNT_USE_BGNG_YMD , A.PRNMNT_USE_BGNG_HR , A.PRNMNT_USE_END_YMD , A.PRNMNT_USE_END_HR , A.RCPT_UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD , D.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS RCPT_UNT_TASKWK_SE_NM , A.CLR_NO , C##RG.DEC_B64(G.FLNM_ENCPT) AS CLR_NM , A.RCPT_INST_NO , H.INST_NM AS RCPT_INST_NM , A.RQST_TRPR_INFO_NO , I.TRPR_NM_ENCPT AS RQST_TRPR_INFO_NM , I.INDV_IDNTFC_NO AS INDV_IDNTFC_NO , A.CASE_MNG_NO , A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO , A.RQST_APLY_YN , A.RQST_DTL_CN , A.LINK_TYPE_SE_CD , E.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS LINK_TYPE_SE_NM , A.ATFINO , A.TRMN_PRCS_YN , A.RQST_INST_NO , J.INST_NM AS RQST_INST_NM , I.CASE_TRPR_NOAP_CS_SE_CD , I.CASE_MNG_SE_CD , K.STU_AGRE_STS_CD , K.STTY_AGT_AGRE_STS_CD , K.ESB_SEQ , I.PRVC_PVSN_AGRE_YN FROM SEB400 A, SAC100 B, SAC100 C, SAC100 D, SAC100 E, SCA100 F, SCA100 G, SAA000 H, SEA200 I, SAA000 J, CAD100 K WHERE 1=1 AND A.RQST_UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = B.CMMNS_CD_VALUE(+) AND 'RQST_UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD' = B.CMMNS_CD_ID(+) AND A.RCPT_RQST_COURS_SE_CD = C.CMMNS_CD_VALUE(+) AND 'RCPT_RQST_COURS_SE_CD' = C.CMMNS_CD_ID(+) AND A.RCPT_UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = D.CMMNS_CD_VALUE(+) AND 'RCPT_UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD' = D.CMMNS_CD_ID(+) AND A.LINK_TYPE_SE_CD = E.CMMNS_CD_VALUE(+) AND 'LINK_TYPE_SE_CD' = E.CMMNS_CD_ID(+) AND A.CLINT_NO = F.ENFSN_NO(+) AND A.CLR_NO = G.ENFSN_NO(+) AND A.RCPT_INST_NO = H.INST_NO(+) AND A.RQST_TRPR_INFO_NO = I.TRPR_INFO_NO(+) AND A.RQST_INST_NO = J.INST_NO(+) AND A.LINK_SN = K.ESB_SEQ(+) ) T1, SEB420 T2 WHERE 1=1 AND T1. SRVC_PVSN_RQST_NO = T2.SRVC_PVSN_RQST_NO AND T2.LINK_TYPE_SE_CD = '06' AND T2.RCPT_SN = (CASE WHEN T2.RCPT_SE_CD = '40' THEN (SELECT MAX(RCPT_SN) FROM SEB420 WHERE SRVC_PVSN_RQST_NO = T2.SRVC_PVSN_RQST_NO AND RCPT_UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = 'U03') ELSE ((SELECT MAX(RCPT_SN) FROM SEB420 WHERE SRVC_PVSN_RQST_NO = T2.SRVC_PVSN_RQST_NO) )END) ) TT1
